item.title: Great offer at second Elite Angora veld ram auction
item.description: The most expensive Angora ram offered by House of Fibre at the Elite veld ram auction, held on 22 January at the Botanical Sports Ground in Graaff-Reinet, fetched R40 000.

item.title: Regenerative agriculture project empowers smallholder farmers in Mozambique
item.description: Solidaridad, the HEINEKEN Africa Foundation, Kvuno and Hiveonline have launched the Promoting Regenerative Agriculture for Sustainable Livelihoods (PRASL) project in Mozambique. The project is aimed at strengthening smallholder farmers’ adoption of regenerative agricultural practices that restore ecosystems, improve soil health and build resilient rural communities.

item.title: How pineapple leaves can help fight pollution and crime
item.description: South African scientists have discovered that pineapple leaves, long regarded as agricultural waste, can be transformed into a powerful, low-cost material that tackles two pressing challenges: water pollution and forensic investigation.

item.title: Shared facilities hamper FMD control for communal livestock farmers
item.description: The foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) outbreak continues to ravage South Africa’s livestock farming community, with the unique challenges of communal farming systems making disease control nearly impossible for many black farmers.

item.title: Leading the SA Boer goat breed into the future
item.description: Chantelle Smit is the newly appointed breed director of the SA Boer Goat Breeders’ Association (SABGBA). It is a prestigious position, but it is also a position that calls for responsibility, especially within such a pivotal industry.

item.title: FMD outbreaks reshape economic outlook for South Africa’s livestock sector
item.description: According to analysis released by the Bureau for Food and Agricultural Policy (BFAP), the scale of foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) infections recorded during 2025 has significantly altered earlier projections, shifting the livestock industry into what economists now describe as a high-disease-burden environment.

item.title: Diesel price drops by 50c
item.description: Lower international fuel prices and a stronger rand against the dollar have helped fuel prices decrease this month. This may bring some relief to farmers in the summer grain areas who are still busy planting.

item.title: FMD | Disease moves closer to Northern Cape border
item.description: There is concern that a potential outbreak of foot-and-mouth disease in the western Free State could lead to the disease spreading to the Northern Cape.
